verbs.description: Delete archived sessions older than the retention. This is the only irreversible operation here, so it dry-runs unless dry_run is explicitly false.

params.description: Archive retention in days. There is no default: deleting needs a number somebody chose.
params.name: days

params.description: Defaults to true. Pass false to delete.
params.name: dry_run

verbs.description: Search archived transcripts for words, ignoring case, and return the lines as search hits. This is the archive's live `transcripts` source: the search service calls it at query time and only when asked for the source by name. Only `query`, `project` and `limit` narrow it; the other filters are accepted and ignored.

params.description: Restrict to project directories containing this substring.
params.name: project

verbs.description: Put one archived session back into the live tree, transcript and sidecar together. Refuses rather than overwrites when the live copy already exists.

params.description: Project directory name, as status reports it.
params.name: project

verbs.description: Recent sweeps and prunes, newest first.
Regex-search archived transcripts without unpacking them. Returns at most 200 matching lines.

params.description: Restrict to project directories containing this substring.
params.name: project

verbs.description: Report the live session tree and the archive: session count, orphaned sidecars, bytes, and how many sessions are past the retention and still unswept. past_retention is the backlog — a sweep that runs while that number grows is not working.

params.description: Retention in days. A session is aged when its newest file, transcript or sidecar, is older than this. Default 7.
params.name: days

params.description: Also report how much of the archive is older than this many days.
params.name: prune_days

verbs.description: Gzip every session older than the retention into the archive and remove it from the live tree. The unit is the session, so a transcript and its sidecar directory move together. Reversible with restore.

params.description: Retention in days. A session is aged when its newest file, transcript or sidecar, is older than this. Default 7.
params.name: days

params.description: Report what would move, and move nothing.
params.name: dry_run
